label: PE-11(2)
title: Alternate Power Supply — Self-contained

statement.prose: Provide an alternate power supply for the system that is activated {{ insert: param, pe-11.02_odp.01 }} and that is:

children.label: (b)
children.prose: Not reliant on external power generation; and

children.label: (c)
children.prose: Capable of maintaining {{ insert: param, pe-11.02_odp.02 }} in the event of an extended loss of the primary power source.

guidance: The provision of a long-term, self-contained power supply can be satisfied by using one or more generators with sufficient capacity to meet the needs of the organization.
